comments.content: 1. `server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/search/SearchService.java:552` — Scroll continuations use the original shard request’s transport version instead of the current channel’s version. During a rolling upgrade, an initial scroll created through a new coordinator and continued through an old coordinator with `error_trace=true` sees the header as absent, clears the exception stack trace, and returns an error without the requested trace.

2. `x-pack/plugin/async-search/src/internalClusterTest/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/search/AsyncSearchErrorTraceIT.java:180` — The captured async search uses `wait_for_completion_timeout=0ms` and assertions run immediately after submission without polling that execution. On a busy node, the request returns before shard execution logs anything, so the “seen” tests fail intermittently; the “unseen” test can pass before an incorrect log is emitted.
